scope_zh: 仅整理已归档 extra9gate runner/config 与原 gate plan 的实际 fixture/helper 绑定合同；没有绑定新 head/tree，没有主机探测，也没有运行任何构建或测试。
short_required_actions_zh: 等待实际 fmt/fix 结束并固定最终源码 head/tree/manifest/count；不能用仍运行的 ac003 202-source 维护，或未经过该次维护的 205-source 提案，替代下一次测试的实际来源。
对下列已核 target 建立实际解析清单：每个 helper 由本次 nextest/Cargo 元数据提供，还是由固定 FIXTURE_BINDINGS 外部注入。跨包依赖特别核 test_stdio_server、codex 及 Linux sandbox/execve helpers。此清单是原计划已知的最低范围，不是全 workspace 所有 fixture 的穷尽证明。
每个外部注入项必须有实际同源构建记录、成功终态、准确 package/bin/profile/target、原工作树与 Cargo.lock 身份、实际 executable 路径和 SHA256；已有同源 artifact 可复用，只有路径存在或来自旧 target 缓存不足。
将实际文件 canonical 路径、binary SHA256、证据文件 canonical 路径和其 Git blob，连同两项源码身份写入精确七字段 FIXTURE_BINDINGS。全局 fixture_evidence_blob 必须指向已审证据；空 bindings 也必须解释全部所需 helper 如何由本次真实 metadata 提供。
最终只绑定已经审过的数据字面量：runner 内 FIXED_CONFIG 与传入 config 必须完全相同，FIXTURE_BINDINGS 也要固定；实际绑定后的 script/config/request 再核 hash。不得只在父 shell 设置变量，因为 runner 会清除所有继承的 binary metadata 变量。
保留原九命令、local profile、--locked/--offline/--retries 0、同一个总 end 和证据预留；fixture 准备构建不算测试 gate，也不替代完整无过滤 just test。

existing_config_paths.status: Historical configuration literals, not current host observations or same-source proof.
existing_config_paths.no_assumed_executable_path: This checklist assigns no current absolute binary path; use the actual canonical path from the successful same-source build/artifact record.

exact_binding_schema.source_head_and_tree: Must equal the final config's exact source head and tree.
exact_binding_schema.path: Existing canonical absolute executable path; resolve(strict=True) must equal the path.
exact_binding_schema.sha256: SHA256 of the actual executable bytes selected for injection.
exact_binding_schema.evidence_path: Existing canonical absolute file containing the reviewed same-source build/artifact evidence.
exact_binding_schema.evidence_git_blob: Git blob of the actual evidence_path bytes, checked by runner.
exact_binding_schema.environment_keys: Unique keys matching (CARGO_BIN_EXE_|NEXTEST_BIN_EXE_)[A-Za-z0-9_-]+; values are set to path.
exact_binding_schema.state: No example values are bound by this artifact.

resolver_and_runner_contract.inherited_binary_environment: Runner removes all inherited CARGO_BIN_EXE_* and NEXTEST_BIN_EXE_* before fixed bindings are injected.
resolver_and_runner_contract.selection_precedence: Cargo exact target name, Cargo hyphens-to-underscores alias, Nextest exact name, Nextest alias. Underscore-only names have one key per prefix.
resolver_and_runner_contract.invalid_explicit_value: An explicitly present invalid higher-priority Cargo path fails; the resolver does not fall back to nextest or infer from target-directory contents.
resolver_and_runner_contract.same_package_metadata: Current-run nextest metadata may supply same-package binaries. Do not assume a -p or --lib run supplies a different package's executable.
resolver_and_runner_contract.runfiles: Record actual RUNFILES_MANIFEST_ONLY/runfiles mode when interpreting resolution. The resolver's runfiles branch is distinct from its ordinary absolute-path branch; do not claim the ordinary branch ran merely because a path was supplied.
resolver_and_runner_contract.runner_checks: check_fixture_bindings validates exact schema, same head/tree declarations, canonical paths, executable access, binary SHA256, evidence-file Git hash and unique env keys before and after all gates.
resolver_and_runner_contract.proof_limit: Runner compares reviewed identities; it does not compile helpers or infer build provenance from their bytes. fixture_evidence_blob is a reviewed evidence reference, not itself a semantic proof generated by the runner.

required_evidence_per_external_artifact: Final source commit/tree, clean physical source before/after preparation, source manifest identity and Cargo.lock identity.

Actual package/bin build command, cwd, profile, target triple, selected toolchain and existing dependency inputs; complete original output and true exit status. No dependency installation or repair is implied.
Actual executable/artifact path from that build or a previously verified same-source record; canonical path, byte length and SHA256. If copied, retain source/destination equality and copy provenance.
Exact environment keys used and which suites need them; ensure no explicit older Cargo alias overrides fresh nextest metadata.
Reviewed evidence JSON/file exact bytes plus Git blob; bind its canonical path in each applicable item and reference the combined reviewed evidence via config.fixture_evidence_blob.
Actual pre/post runner observations must remain equal. Reusing a file from the shared operator target requires the same evidence as any other artifact.
conditional_and_scope_limits_zh: Core common 保留原 arg0/current_exe sandbox 分支；不要为了统一表格改测试，也不要把当前测试二进制当作已验证的外部 standalone helper。
codex-code-mode-host 在已读 AppServer helper 中有实际 runfiles 条件；rmcp_test_server 与 notify-capture 的 target 存在不能冒充特定测试已执行。
Linux /bin/sh、sleep、进程组信号、socket/loopback 和 Python3 hook 是原测试环境依赖；记录实际可用性和 skip/early-return，不改为假 fixture，也不算同源业务材料。
本次未验证最终 workspace 的全部 binary 元数据；Root 绑定时还需保留该最终源码实际测试/target roster，不能从历史 fixed199 清单推断没有其它 helper。
原 source-qualified component 通过不能证明普通业务/Root/独立C验收；本清单不改变 0/0/0。
